question: Which powers are identified as part of the eight siddhis?
premises: The verse names mastery, irresistible will, and attainment.
The term iti indicates an enumeration.
These are grouped as the eight siddhis.
inference: Mastery, irresistible will, and attainment are included among the eight siddhis to be placed.
uncertainties: Only three of the eight siddhis are explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: Mastery, irresistible will, and attainment are thus among the eight siddhis.
